main_text.p: 18 Fugite fcortationem : omne peccatum quodcunq; fecerit homo, extra corpus eft, at qui fcortatur, in proprium corpus peccat.

Poftremò fcortatio, Deum qui tum poffeffionis, eos enim fpiritu fuo tenet, & occupat verf. 19. tum redemptionis iure, eos enim fanguine fuo redemit, & fibi in peculium acquifiuit. verf: 20. credentium proprietatem habet, eoq; nomine omnem eorum vfum fibi foli vendicare poteft, debito honore fraudat, & magna iniuria afficit.
19 Nefcitis quod corpus veftrum templum eft fpiritus fancti qui in vobis, quem habetis à Deo, & non eftis veftri ipforum.
20 Nam pretio empti eftis: glorificate igitur Deum in corpore veftro, & in fpiritu veftro, quae funt Dei.

page.notes: The marginal mark at the lower left of the text block ("ꟽ") is a reference sign; the "Verf 1." line at the lower right is a catchline-style reference. Left margin edge contains only fragments of the adjoining page and was not transcribed. Some letters in the scan are uncertain (e.g. "poffeffionis", "Verf 1"), but were read as printed.
